datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT rowid,a.*
FROM sbcm_tranches_new a
where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     cont.amount,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid
from customers cust,
     sbcm_contracts_new cont
where
cont.id = :ContractID and 
cust.id = cont.customerid

datasets.name: DebitAccs
datasets.sql:
select 
       id,
       acc_no,
       name
from account 
where close_dat is null
and  bal_cn1 in ( select accgroup from sbcm_acc_zone_info
where zoneid = (select zoneid from sbcm_acc_zones_new
where name = 'Deposit'))
and id in(select CONTRACTACCID from sbcm_contract_accounts_new where id#=:contractid)

datasets.name: CreditAccs
datasets.sql:
select 
       id,
       acc_no,
       name
from account
